exposure: Malignant gastrointestinal stromal tumour (GIST) during pregnancy
outcome: Delivery via elective repeat cesarean section
No evidence of local disease or distant metastasis postpartum
cohort: A 36-year-old gravida 2 para 1 woman diagnosed with a malignant gastrointestinal stromal tumour (GIST) presenting with acute abdominal pain at 9 weeks gestation.
finding: A malignant gastrointestinal stromal tumour (GIST) presenting as an acute abdomen in the first trimester can be successfully managed by a multidisciplinary team, leading to good maternal and fetal outcomes with no postpartum evidence of disease recurrence.
